audit_metadata.scope: Complete repository codebase, architecture, pages, security, accessibility, and customer journeys

issues.description: Absence of Security HTTP Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) in the hosting server.
issues.evidence: python -m http.server returns raw headers without Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options: DENY, or X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Verified via curl -I / python response inspection.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Vulnerable to clickjacking, unauthorized script execution, MIME-confusion attacks, and protocol downgrade MITM attacks in production.
issues.recommended_solution: Deploy a reverse proxy (Nginx, Caddy, Cloudflare, or AWS CloudFront) configuring strict HSTS (max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and a restrictive CSP.
issues.verification_steps: Send HTTP HEAD request via curl -I and verify all 5 security headers are present with correct directives.

issues.description: Client-Side Only Authentication & Broken Access Control (Host/Owner Suite is entirely unprotected).
issues.evidence: Any visitor can navigate to #owner-overview or fetch /roomly_owner_property_management_dashboard/code.html directly without authentication, session cookies, or JWT verification. Rajesh Sharma's portfolio, yield, and tenant KYC data is exposed.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Severe breach of tenant and landlord privacy. Critical compliance failure under India Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023) and Consumer Protection Act.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement server-side authentication (OAuth 2.0 / JWT / HttpOnly session cookies) with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Protect /owner-overview behind server-side middleware and authentication gate.
issues.dependencies: Authentication backend service and database schema
issues.verification_steps: Attempt direct GET request to /owner-overview without valid session cookie. Must return HTTP 401/403 or redirect to /login.

issues.description: Complete absence of an application backend service, database, and transaction engine.
issues.evidence: Entire project runs on a dev-only Python http.server without REST API, database (PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB), or ORM. Inquiries, KYC documents, and token deposits cannot be stored or audited.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Platform cannot conduct business. Token reservations (₹999) and visit requests are simulated in browser memory and lost immediately upon page refresh.
issues.recommended_solution: Build production backend service (Node.js/Express, FastAPI, or NestJS) with PostgreSQL database, Prisma/SQLAlchemy ORM, and automated migration pipeline.
issues.verification_steps: Submit booking form, verify row insertion in PostgreSQL 'reservations' table, and check webhook dispatch.

issues.description: Unsanitized innerHTML assignment in client-side page loader creates DOM XSS vulnerability vector.
issues.evidence: In index.html line 431: 'root.innerHTML = doc.body.innerHTML;'. If routing fetches external or query-manipulated content, malicious scripts could be executed in client context.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Potential session hijacking, credentials theft, or malicious defacement if an injection vector enters the response stream.
issues.recommended_solution: Sanitize injected HTML using DOMPurify before inserting into root element: DOMPurify.sanitize(doc.body.innerHTML), or transition to a framework with built-in virtual DOM sanitization.
issues.verification_steps: Inject test payload containing and verify payload is neutralized without execution.

issues.description: Modal dialogs lack keyboard focus trapping, ARIA roles, and Escape key dismissal (WCAG 2.1.2, 2.4.3).
issues.evidence: showVisitModal and showTokenModal inject a simple div into #mc without role='dialog', aria-modal='true', or aria-labelledby. Tabbing moves focus to background elements behind the modal. Pressing Escape does not close the modal.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Screen reader and keyboard-only users become disoriented or trapped, preventing them from scheduling visits or closing prompts.
issues.recommended_solution: Add role='dialog' aria-modal='true' to #mb, save previously focused element, set focus to first input, trap Tab key within modal, and bind Escape key to closeModal().
issues.verification_steps: Open visit modal using keyboard only, press Tab repeatedly (must loop within modal), press Escape (modal must close and return focus to trigger button).

issues.description: Homepage search console parameters (City, Budget, Room Type) are dropped during navigation to Search page.
issues.evidence: Hero search button has href='#search-rentals'. Clicking it executes go('search-rentals') without passing input state (e.g. location='Koramangala', budget='10k-20k'). Search page resets to default state.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: User friction and drop-off: tenants must re-type and re-filter their search criteria after already entering it on the homepage.
issues.recommended_solution: Serialize search form inputs into URL query/hash params (e.g. #search-rentals?loc=Koramangala&type=pg&b=10k-20k) and parse them in search-rentals initScripts() to populate filter controls.
issues.verification_steps: Select 'HSR Layout' and 'Twin Sharing' on homepage, click search, verify Search & Filters page loads with HSR Layout and Twin Sharing pre-selected.

issues.description: Sidebar filter inputs are not wired to filter the listing cards dynamically.
issues.evidence: Toggling checkboxes (e.g. 'Co-Living / Managed PG', 'Private Room') or budget presets does not trigger JavaScript filtering logic; all 6 property cards remain visible regardless of selections.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Frustrates users who expect reactive filtering or filtered results upon clicking 'Apply Filters'.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement a client-side dataset filter function that matches card attributes (data-type, data-price, data-gender) against active filter state and updates card visibility and count badge.
issues.verification_steps: Check 'Private Room in Flat' only; verify listings without matching category are hidden and count badge reflects filtered total.

issues.description: In-browser runtime Tailwind CDN compilation adds significant CPU and LCP latency.
issues.evidence: Script tag loads 'https://cdn.tailwindcss.com' (350+ KB unminified runtime engine). The browser parses and JIT-compiles CSS on the fly on every initial page load and route update.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Degrades Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) on mobile devices by 300–600ms. Tailwind explicitly warns against CDN in production.
issues.recommended_solution: Configure a build step (PostCSS / Tailwind CLI / Vite) to compile a purge-optimized static CSS bundle (under 30 KB minified/gzipped).
issues.verification_steps: Measure initial CSS parse and load time before and after. Verify precompiled stylesheet loads in < 50ms without runtime compile overhead.

issues.description: Client-side hash routing prevents search engine indexation of individual property and city landing pages.
issues.evidence: Content is rendered dynamically into #app-root via fetch and DOMParser based on window.location.hash. Search crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot) do not reliably execute hash-change routing.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Zero organic search visibility for high-intent keywords like 'PG in Koramangala' or '2BHK in HSR Layout', devastating tenant acquisition.
issues.recommended_solution: Migrate to HTML5 History API with server routing rewrites or implement Server-Side Rendering (SSR / SSG) so each URL serves distinct, crawlable HTML with tailored meta tags.
issues.verification_steps: Fetch /search-rentals via curl without JavaScript. Verify full listing content and metadata are present in initial HTML.

issues.description: External third-party CDN assets loaded without Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes.
issues.evidence: <script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script> and Google Fonts stylesheets lack integrity and crossorigin attributes.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: If CDN DNS or edge cache is compromised, malicious script can be executed in user browser without detection.
issues.recommended_solution: Bundle scripts locally or add valid SRI hashes (integrity='sha384-...' crossorigin='anonymous') to all external scripts.
issues.verification_steps: Inspect network panel and verify SRI hashes are enforced on external scripts.

issues.description: Listing creation wizard lacks multi-step state progression and form validation.
issues.evidence: Clicking 'Continue to Photos & KYC' or 'Back to Dashboard' does not advance the stepper to Step 4. Inputs lack validation for required values (rent > 0, valid phone number).
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Landlords cannot complete the property onboarding workflow; listings are lost.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement a wizard step controller that validates current step inputs, persists draft state in localStorage/API, and transitions the DOM to Step 4 and Step 5.
issues.verification_steps: Fill Step 3, click Continue, verify Step 4 is revealed with active stepper indicator and draft saved.

issues.description: High-resolution property images lack modern formats (AVIF/WebP), responsive srcset, and explicit dimensions.
issues.evidence: Images loaded directly from Google public storage (lh3.googleusercontent.com) as full-resolution files without width/height attributes or loading='lazy' (except for hero images).
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Excessive cellular data consumption on mobile networks and layout shifts (CLS) as images load.
issues.recommended_solution: Add loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to below-the-fold images, specify aspect-ratio/width/height in CSS to eliminate CLS, and serve WebP/AVIF images via image CDN.
issues.verification_steps: Verify Lighthouse Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) score is < 0.05 and images below the fold load lazily on scroll.

issues.description: Missing Open Graph, Twitter Cards, Canonical tags, and JSON-LD Structured Data.
issues.evidence: Head only contains description and title. Missing og:title, og:image, og:url, og:type, twitter:card, and Schema.org RealEstateListing or LodgingBusiness JSON-LD markup.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Shared links on WhatsApp, LinkedIn, or Twitter render as plain text without preview cards; search engines cannot parse structured amenities and pricing.
issues.recommended_solution: Add Open Graph and Twitter meta tags to index.html and dynamically inject JSON-LD structured data on property details view.
issues.verification_steps: Test URL using Facebook Sharing Debugger or Google Rich Results Test; verify valid rich card and RealEstateListing schema.

issues.description: Decorative Material Symbols lack aria-hidden='true', causing verbose screen reader announcements.
issues.evidence: verified is read aloud as the literal icon name string ('verified', 'single_bed', 'payments') by NVDA/VoiceOver.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Screen reader users experience noisy and confusing audio feedback.
issues.recommended_solution: Add aria-hidden='true' to all decorative icon spans that accompany textual labels. For standalone icon buttons, ensure an explicit aria-label exists.
issues.verification_steps: Audit with axe DevTools or NVDA screen reader; confirm icon names are not redundantly announced.

issues.description: Lack of data normalization and audit logging schema for financial escrow transactions and tenant KYC records.
issues.evidence: Platform markets 'Consumer Protection Act 2019 compliance' and 'Dual-consent digital escrow account', but lacks any schema for escrow ledgers, audit trails, dispute lifecycles, and Aadhaar hashing.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Legal and regulatory liability in India. Storing raw Aadhaar or unverified escrow states violates UIDAI guidelines and RBI payment regulations.
issues.recommended_solution: Design relational PostgreSQL schema with isolated tables: users, properties, units, kyc_records (with masked Aadhaar and audit log), escrow_transactions, and dispute_cases with strict foreign key constraints.
issues.verification_steps: Review DB migration scripts and ensure immutable audit_logs table with cryptographic checksums.

issues.description: Subpage HTML re-renders inject redundant duplicate header and footer DOM nodes into #app-root.
issues.evidence: Subpages contain full <html>, <head>, <header>, <main>, <footer> tags. In index.html line 431, doc.body.innerHTML is injected, creating nested header and footer structures inside #app-root.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: DOM tree bloat, potential CSS selector specificity collision, and duplicate accessibility landmark regions (multiple banner and contentinfo landmarks violate WCAG).
issues.recommended_solution: Extract header and footer into shared index.html layout shell; subpages should only provide the <main> content view, or subpage parser should only inject doc.querySelector('main').innerHTML.
issues.verification_steps: Inspect DOM with Chrome DevTools after navigation; confirm exactly one <header> and one <footer> exist on page.

issues.description: Brittle text-matching event listener attachments in initScripts().
issues.evidence: In index.html: if(t === 'Schedule Visit' || t === 'Book Free In-Person Visit') ... if(t.startsWith('Token') || t.startsWith('Reserve Now')). If button copy is changed or translated, event handlers silently break.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: High regression risk: minor marketing copy adjustments disable critical booking and visit conversion flows.
issues.recommended_solution: Replace string text matching with semantic data-action attributes, e.g. data-action='schedule-visit', data-action='reserve-token', data-action='add-listing'.
issues.verification_steps: Change button text to 'Book Your Visit Now'; verify modal still triggers reliably via data-action.

issues.description: Move-in date selector in booking engine lacks minimum date constraints and calendar picker validation.
issues.evidence: Date input allows past dates to be typed or selected.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Tenants can accidentally submit reservations for dates in the past.
issues.recommended_solution: Set min attribute to current date: input.min = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] and disable dates further than 60 days in advance.
issues.verification_steps: Inspect date input in booking widget; confirm dates prior to today are disabled in calendar.

issues.description: Lack of real-time availability indicator and bed freeze countdown timer.
issues.evidence: Booking engine states 'Only 1 bed remaining' statically without real-time synchronization or countdown expiration timer for holding beds.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Reduced conversion urgency and potential double-booking disputes if two tenants reserve the same bed.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement a real-time reservation hold countdown timer (e.g. '14:59 to complete token deposit') backed by WebSocket or server session lock.
issues.verification_steps: Initiate booking hold; verify 15-minute countdown starts and bed is locked across other browser sessions.

issues.description: Sort dropdown in search bar has hidden label (<label class='sr-only'>) but lacks visible label or clear accessible description.
issues.evidence: <select id='sort-dropdown'> uses a swap_vert icon next to it without visible text label.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Users with cognitive disabilities may not immediately recognize the icon as a sorting mechanism.
issues.recommended_solution: Add a visible label 'Sort by:' next to the select dropdown or include placeholder 'Sort: Recommended'.
issues.verification_steps: Confirm text label 'Sort by:' is visible and associated with select element via for='sort-dropdown'.

issues.description: Redundant inline Tailwind config inside each HTML subpage alongside centralized tokens.css.
issues.evidence: Tailwind configuration script tag is repeated across index.html and all 5 subpages with duplicate color definitions.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Maintenance overhead: changing a token requires editing 6 files instead of just tokens.css.
issues.recommended_solution: Consolidate theme configuration into a single shared script file (tailwind-theme.js) or standard build configuration.
issues.verification_steps: Edit a token in shared theme file; confirm all pages inherit update instantly.

issues.description: Total absence of automated test suites (Unit, Integration, E2E).
issues.evidence: Zero test files (*.test.js, *.spec.js, package.json scripts) exist in the repository.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: High risk of silent regressions during future feature updates or refactoring.
issues.recommended_solution: Introduce Vitest for unit tests (routing, date calculations, validation) and Playwright for E2E user journey testing (visit scheduling, filtering, room selection).
issues.verification_steps: Run 'npm test' or 'npx playwright test' and confirm automated tests pass in CI/CD pipeline.

issues.description: Missing verified resident testimonials and video reviews social proof section.
issues.evidence: Marketplace features comparison matrices and stats, but lacks authentic customer quotes, tenant photos, or verified ratings from corporate employees.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: First-time tenants relocating to a new city need strong social proof to trust an unfamiliar platform with deposit money.
issues.recommended_solution: Add a dedicated 'Stories from Verified Tenants' carousel featuring real reviews from Infosys, Google, and Flipkart tenants with star ratings and verified badges.
issues.verification_steps: Inspect homepage for verified review cards with tenant name, company badge, and verified stay link.

issues.description: Privacy Policy and Terms links point to empty hash (#) placeholders.
issues.evidence: Footer links for 'Privacy Policy', 'Terms of Tenancy', and 'Zero Brokerage Policy' have href='#' without functional pages.
issues.customer_or_business_impact: Legal compliance exposure under Indian IT Rules and consumer protection transparency requirements.
issues.recommended_solution: Create dedicated legal modal dialogs or routes (#privacy-policy, #terms-of-tenancy) detailing data collection, escrow handling, and dispute resolution terms.
issues.verification_steps: Click 'Privacy Policy' in footer; verify full privacy policy dialog or page opens.
